system.description:
Water Release: Viscous Water Mass · cast at S-Rank · no type

+4 AC and +10 DR (double DR against fire damage).

When you take damage, you can end it on yourself to gain resistance to that damage type.

Cast at S-Rank, it affects every willing creature of the caster's choice within a 30-foot radius.
